title: Implement Cost Tracking & Ledger
description:
Implement a cost tracking system using `thefactory-db` Entities within a consolidated `llmCosts` module.

We will use a dual-entity approach:
1. **Ledger Entries**: Atomic, immutable records of every LLM call (`cost-ledger-entry`). We will use `shouldEmbed: false` to avoid unnecessary tokenization costs.
2. **Aggregates**: Mutable entities (`cost-aggregate`) that store running totals for various scopes (Chat, Story, Feature, Project, Group) to allow O(1) cost retrieval.

This system requires implementing:
- `LLMCostsTools` interface and implementation.
- `PricingManager` logic consolidated into the module.
- Logic to append ledger entries and recursively update aggregate entities.
- Integration with the completion pipeline to automatically track costs.
- Read-methods to fetch costs for specific scopes.
- Standardized file structure (`types`, `constants`, `helpers`, `utils`, `Tools`).

features.title: Implement LLMCostsTools and Module Structure
features.description:
Create a consolidated `src/llmCosts` module following the project's tool conventions (like `src/file/*`):

- `llmCostsTypes.ts`: types for scopes, ledger entry content/entity, aggregate content/entity, tool interface.
- `llmCostsConstants.ts`: entity type strings (`cost-ledger-entry`, `cost-aggregate`) and any key formats.
- `llmCostsUtils.ts`: pure helpers (e.g., model key formatting, zero aggregate factory).
- `llmCostsHelpers.ts`: reusable functions with dependencies (e.g., db match/update logic).
- `LLMCostsTools.ts`: `LLMCostsTools` interface + implementation.

Implement `LLMCostsTools` methods:
- `appendCost`: calculate cost using consolidated pricing logic, create a `cost-ledger-entry` entity (`shouldEmbed: false`), and update `cost-aggregate` entities for all relevant scopes (agentRun/chat/feature/story/project; group to be supported when groupId is available).
- `getCost`: retrieve the `cost-aggregate` for a specific scope.
- `getCostTotals`: return totals for a scope (initially alias of `getCost` or returns the content only).

Ensure `shouldEmbed: false` is used for all cost-related entities.

features.title: Integrate Cost Tracking into Completions
features.description:
Integrate `CostTools` into `Tools` and `CompletionTools`. Ensure that every `sendCompletion` call (or relevant wrapper) automatically calls `appendCost`.

- Add `CostTools` to the `Tools` interface and `createTools`.
- In `CompletionTools` (or `sendCompletion` logic), automatically track usage after a successful LLM call.
- Pass the necessary context (Chat/Story/Project IDs) down to the completion layer so it can properly attribute the cost.

features.title: Add Tests for Cost Tracking
features.description: Expose a way for tests to reset costs or spy on them. Add tests verifying that `appendCost` correctly updates the `cost-ledger-entry` and all parent `cost-aggregate` entities. Verify correctness of calculations and handling of different pricing models (input, output, cached).
